citations.quote: The heating fails every few days and the flat drops to around 15 degrees before it comes back on.
That is nonsense, but the cause has to be established somehow, and the only way I can see is an independent heating expert examining the system.
Before I take that step, I'd like your confirmation that I have done everything correctly so far.
As my letter says, I will pay the rent into the official deposit if the heating is not repaired.
The heating in my flat at Eichholzweg 48 has been failing repeatedly.
I hereby set a deadline: the heating must be repaired by 3 September 2026.
Having looked into your complaint, we must point out that in our opinion the failures are caused by your ventilation habits.
To rule out any technical fault, we will nevertheless have the control unit replaced as soon as our supplier delivers it.
Our heating installer will need access to your flat on 13 November 2026 between 8 and 10 a.m.
